period_design_rules.rockets_black: 2017-18 Nike Statement, sleeveless black with white HOUSTON, narrow white numbers, red collar and shorts trim, subtle dark side pattern.
period_design_rules.rockets_red: 2017-18 Nike Icon, red with white ROCKETS, white narrow numbers and silver/white curved side panels.
period_design_rules.rockets_white: 2017-18 Nike Association, white with red ROCKETS and narrow red numbers, red/silver curved side panels.
period_design_rules.rockets_marks: Nike Swoosh on wearer right chest. Rockets sponsor patch area is empty in2017-18. ROKiT begins2018-19. NBA logo at rear neckline.
period_design_rules.design_dates: Use 2017-18 cuts, period typography and shorts. Modern Jumpman, current redesigned kits, later sponsor patches and modern arena names would be period errors.

authored_game_choices.status: Creative choice of period-correct designs; follows the visually verified Houston-home series palette.
authored_game_choices.players: Paul healthy; Iguodala remains unavailable under the baseline. Full fifteen-player team may appear in celebration photos.

authored_game_choices.chosen_opponent_kit: white 2017-18 Cavaliers Association CAVS with wine/gold trim
authored_game_choices.status: Creative choice of period-correct contrasting designs. Houston has Finals homecourt, so Game6 is in Cleveland.

availability_guards: Luc Mbah a Moute is injured/inactive during Minnesota games. His regular-season credit and later Utah/WCF participation are coherent.
Ryan Anderson missed Minnesota Games1-2, returned Game3.
Ricky Rubio is unavailable throughout the Houston series. Dante Exum is available in Utah Game2 and inactive in Game5.
Iguodala is active WCF Games1-3 and unavailable Games4-7. McCaw returns by real Game6.
The story retains healthy Paul after WCFGame5; any image of him actively playing Game6 is an authored scene using the actual game attire.
Onuaku and Zhou are part of the full fifteen-player playoff squad, with game-specific active/inactive status.
court_venue_guards: Toyota Center has red key/baseline surroundings and the Rockets R center logo.
Target Center has the 2017 Wolves circular center logo, navy painted areas and Target Center floor text.
ORACLE Arena is in Oakland with period yellow/blue court details. The Town special center-court treatment should be checked when recreating Game4 wide shots.
Quicken Loans Arena is the 2018 Cleveland venue name.
Championship rings belong in a later ceremony, after the trophy-night imagery.
known_unknowns: Minnesota Game4 Houston color is supported by the official NBA YouTube image and contemporaneous team photo; a direct gameplay frame remains unextracted.
Exact shoe models, uniform seam geometry and fine arena architectural details have not received exhaustive comparison.
source_quality_notes: NBA recap thumbnails can be reused or unrelated. The MIN Game3 recap thumbnail shows Butler in white while dated actual game photographs show Wolves navy. The MIN Game4 recap thumbnail points to a Wall/Harden image. Those two recap thumbnails are rejected as game-specific uniform evidence.
References are for historical QA and visual direction, with private inspection previews retained.
